does: Makes a new client entity for a timeline dummy: takes a uuid and a timeline type, creates the entity in the client world at once, gives it ls::uuid::Component, ecl::TimelineTransformComponent and ecl::TLPreviewDummy, writes the timeline type, the entity handle (0x30) and the entity reference (0x10) into the dummy and returns the dummy.

evidence.says: The body takes the client world from ecl::EoCClient+0x1A8, creates an entity, adds the three components in that order and fills the dummy's fields at 0x10, 0x18 and 0xB9; the Toolkit's ecl::TLPreviewDummyHelpers::CreateDummy(Guid const&, ETimelineType) has the same two parameters and the same job.

A probe while a dialog starts records 93 calls with a pointer to a uuid and the timeline type 1, each returning a dummy whose address is then given to the load; the callers are the three dummy-making functions of the timeline system.
